_about: Wire contract consumed by Milo-Mac (github.com/leodurandfr/Milo-Mac), a SECOND API client beyond frontend/. Milo-Mac is a separate macOS app, not in this checkout, with no API versioning: if the backend drops a route or WS event listed here, Milo-Mac breaks silently at runtime. This manifest is the SOURCE OF TRUTH for that contract. Seeded 2026-06-10 from MiloAPIService.swift (REST) and WebSocketService.swift (WS). Enforced offline on every pytest run by test_milo_mac_contract.py; drift against Milo-Mac's real source is re-checked by the non-blocking CI job check_milo_mac_freshness.py. Update this file CONSCIOUSLY when Milo-Mac evolves — there is no auto-grep anymore.

rest.note: Calls the {target} route with the literal target 'local'. The backend route is templated /api/equalizer/target/{target}/enabled.
Single bulk call that replaced the per-category /api/settings/{volume-limits,volume-steps,dock-apps} GET routes. Reads volume_limits.{min_db,max_db} and dock_apps.enabled_apps from the response.
Called with ?favorites_only=true (query string is not part of the path contract).

ws._about: Each (category, type) below MUST have at least one backend broadcast_event() site. The offline test enforces existence only; payload_invariants are documented for humans + the freshness job, not statically verified.

events.note: Emitted via the variable event_type path in api/settings.py::_handle_setting_update (broadcast_event("settings", event_type, ...)), not as a literal pair.

multiroom_changed_discriminator.meaning: boolean sibling of full_state; true marks the authoritative end of a routing transition (multiroom loading spinner completion).

volume_changed.fallback: data.volume_db (Double or Int) when state is absent
volume_changed.step_note: step_mobile_db is NO LONGER consumed — Milo-Mac's keyboard step is a local setting (GlobalHotkeyManager.volumeDeltaDb). Do not re-couple to it.

routing/multiroom_error.note: presence only; no payload field is read

ws.metadata_is_opaque: Milo-Mac reads full_state.metadata as an opaque [String: Any] dict. NO metadata SUB-field is coupled (uri, client_count, album_art_height, track_position/duration, etc.). An over-emitted metadata sub-field with no frontend/src/ consumer is therefore safe to drop without touching this manifest.

consumer_side_only_NOT_enforced.reason: Milo-Mac has a defensive handler for category 'plugin', but the backend never broadcasts it. NOT a required contract — excluded from the offline test so it stays green.
Keepalive; Milo-Mac explicitly ignores it. Emitted by the WS ping loop, not by broadcast_event(). NOT enforced.
